What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: I think the university system was much more chaotic than what i was used to at UCPH

questions.answer: The italian food and how relaxed the italian people are

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
1. Make sure to find housing as soon as possible, in order to save some money.
2. Do some research on the courses you are selecting, my experience was that many from UCPH chose courses which required prerequisites we didn't have, and made the courses really hard.
3. Be prepared that the university system is more chaotic than UCPH interms of lectures, exams etc.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: I'm not sure

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: I think it was to be thrown into a country where you know no one, and have to fend for yourself. Also experiencing a new culture and studying in a different place and in a different way than you are used to.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Not knowing anyone when i arrived
